name: comp-593
title: Breadcrumb Filter Header
blurb: Breadcrumb report header with date picker and filters.
description: Header with breadcrumb (home icon + page title), date picker, filters panel, and save/bookmark button.
use_when: Report or dashboard interfaces where users filter data by date/range.
avoid_when: Simple content pages; breadcrumbs + filters add navigation weight.
a11y: Breadcrumb navigable. Date picker keyboard-accessible. Filter button has aria-label. Bookmark button labeled.
